exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.
availability.purchase: Installing one is a single deterministic purchase costing exactly two units of its assigned specialized material.

effects.launch_pattern: evenly spaced radial directions from the mech

rules.text: Automatic homing is removed. Every salvo launches its four missiles in evenly spaced radial directions from the mech.
Each missile deals 125% current Damage and has 125% current blast radius.
The four-way launch offset advances 45° clockwise with each salvo. Missiles also curve clockwise at 45° per second, retain current speed and lifetime, and may damage every enemy in their explosions.
The conversion produces predictable sweeping geometry and more raw area output, but no guarantee that any missile follows a priority target.
